about.intro: Rebuild Sports & Fitness Center is a strength and conditioning floor on the ground floor of NityaSukhadham Society in Lal Baug, Parel. Rigs, a numbered sprint turf, rowers and a dumbbell wall — one room, used properly, with a coach on the floor.
about.story:
This is not a hotel gym and it is not a room full of machines facing televisions. It is a working floor: a rig with rings, bars, bands and boxes, a blue sprint turf down the middle, Concept2 rowers and SkiErg, air bikes, sleds and a dumbbell wall that runs from the light pairs to the heavy rack.

Training here is coach-led. Someone watches your setup before your first working set, teaches the positions before adding load, and writes the next block down so you are not guessing when you walk in. Group sessions are scaled to whoever turns up — first-timers are not an inconvenience.

The other half of the room is recovery: a steam suite and an on-site massage room, because a hard week only pays off if you can come back to the next one. Members park on the premises; Currey Road and Chinchpokli are the closest stations.

Come in for a session, or message us and we will tell you honestly where you should start.

announcements.text: Mon–Sat · 6 AM–12 PM & 4–10 PM · Walk in, or message us to book a session

policies.shipping: Memberships and session packs are quoted at the desk or on WhatsApp. Nothing on this site is a checkout — you are sending an enquiry, not paying online. Ask for the current plans before you commit.
policies.returns: Need to move a booked session? Message us a few hours ahead so the slot can go to someone else. First visits start with a short floor induction before any heavy work.

products.name: Strength Floor Access
products.description: The full floor, your own programme. Squat racks, benches, a dumbbell wall from the light pairs to the heavy rack, platforms and bars — with a coach on the floor for a form check when you want one.
products.fabric: Open floor · Mon–Sat, 6 AM–12 PM and 4–10 PM
products.care: Bring flat-soled shoes, a towel and water. Chalk is on the house. Leave the weights where you found them.
products.colour: Anyone who already trains and wants a serious floor without a fixed class time

products.name: Personal Training
products.description: A coach, a plan and a full hour that is only about your goal. Movement screened on day one, technique taught before load, and a programme that is written down so you know what you are doing when you walk in.
products.care: Arrive ten minutes early for the first session. Wear what you can move in; we will start with the basics, not the heaviest set.
products.colour: Beginners, returners after a break, or anyone chasing a specific strength or body-composition goal

products.name: Functional Conditioning
products.description: Sled pushes, carries, rower intervals, ski erg and air-bike work on the numbered sprint turf. Built around the way you actually move — running, climbing, lifting, playing — rather than a single machine.
products.care: Bring shoes you can run in. Intensity is scaled to you, so a first session is hard but never a gamble.
products.colour: Athletes in season, and anyone whose gym work has stopped translating to real life

products.name: Group WOD
products.description: Small-group strength and conditioning on the rig and turf. One workout on the board, scaled three ways, a coach counting reps and fixing positions. Competitive if you want it, quiet if you do not.
products.care: Book the slot you can actually make. Arrive early enough to warm up properly.
products.colour: People who train better with a board, a timer and someone beside them

products.name: Weight-Loss & Recomposition Plan
products.description: A structured block for fat loss that keeps the muscle. Strength sessions, conditioning you can recover from, and simple food guidance you can follow in a Mumbai kitchen — reviewed as the weeks go, not emailed once and forgotten.
products.care: Come for a starting assessment before the block begins so progress is measured, not guessed.
products.colour: Anyone who has lost weight before and put it back on, or wants to change shape without living on the treadmill

products.name: Sports Massage & Deep Tissue
products.description: Deep-tissue work on the areas your training keeps complaining about — hips, hamstrings, calves, upper back. Booked after a hard block or before a heavy week.
products.care: Tell the therapist what is sore and what you are training for. Drink water afterwards and do not book it straight after a max-effort session.
products.colour: Tight hips, desk-bound shoulders, or a training week that will not loosen up

products.name: Steam & Recovery Session
products.description: A steam bath, a quiet corner and twenty minutes where nobody asks you for a rep. The cheapest way to make the rest of the week train better.
products.fabric: Steam suite · member and walk-in slots
products.care: Bring a towel. Skip it if you are dehydrated, unwell or have a heart condition — ask us and we will suggest something else.
products.colour: Heavy training weeks, poor sleep, or a body that needs a reset
